title: ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ
lyrics:
[Intro - Male Solo]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ,
ମଝି ବାଟେ ହଜିଯିବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ଧ୍ରୁବତାରା ବାଟ୍ ଦେଖେଇଦେବା।

[Verse 1 - Male Solo]
ସାଉଁଟି... ସାଉଁଟି...
ସଂସାର୍‌କେ ଜାବ୍‌ଡ଼ି ଧରିଛେଁ—
ଜୁଡ଼ିଦେବାର୍ ଆଶାନେ,
ସଜେଇଦେବାର୍ ଆଶାନେ।

[Verse 2 - Male Solo]
କୁମ୍ଭାର୍ ମୁଇଁ।

ଗଢ଼ିଦେବାର୍ ସିଖିଛେଁ,
ରଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲଗେଇ,
ତୋର୍ ମୁହେଁ ହସ୍ ବୁନ୍‌ବାର୍ ସିଖିଛେଁ।

[Chorus - Male Lead]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ,
ମଝି ବାଟେ ହଜିଯିବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ଧ୍ରୁବତାରା ବାଟ୍ ଦେଖେଇଦେବା।

[Bridge - Male Lead, Soft Female Responses]
ଆ, ପାହାଡ଼୍ ଚଢ଼୍‌ମା।
ଆ, ଜନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ମା।
ବାଦଲ୍ ସାଙ୍ଗେ କାନ୍ଧ୍ ମିଲେଇ,
ବର୍ଷା ହେଇ ଝର୍‌ବାର୍ ମନ୍ତର୍ ସିଖ୍‌ମା।

[Final Chorus - Male and Female Duet]
ମତେ ସପନ୍ ଦେଖ୍‌ବାକେ ମନା ନାଇଁ।
ତୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌କେ ମୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌ନେ
ଗୁଁଥିଦେବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।

[Soft Outro - Both Voices]
ତୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌କେ ମୋର୍ ସପନ୍‌ନେ...
ଗୁଁଥିଦେବାକେ ବି ମନା ନାଇଁ।
style: Soulful Sambalpuri folk ballad with affectionate conversational singing and a gently lilting folk pulse. Warm youthful male lead with natural Sambalpuri pronunciation; solo opening and verses, soft female answering phrases entering at the invitation, both voices together in the final refrain. Use only supplied lyric words. Original memorable melody shaped by local speech cadence, short expressive turns and restrained ornamentation. Bamboo-flute replies, lightly played dhol, soft bass and quiet acoustic guitar. Spacious unhurried verses; refrain blooms with quiet communal joy. Clear breath between the repeated gathering phrases and a fuller pause after the potter declaration, with instruments sustaining underneath. Open the bridge warmly without speeding up. End tenderly with two dreams coming together. No driving dance beat, mournful delivery, dramatic crescendo or added lyrics.
changes: First-person nasal endings in one holding and two learning forms
Section directions for gradual male-female duet; no added sung words

settings.vocal_gender: Unselected; male lead and female responses specified in lyrics/style
